snippet.title: Nordic Ashes: Twilight of Yggdrasil - Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2068280
GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/nordic_ashes_survivors_of_ragnarok
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/es-es/Juegos/Juegos-de-Nintendo-Switch/Nordic-Ashes-The-Complete-Saga-2971414.html
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/es-es/concept/10015993
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/es-ES/games/store/nordic-ashes-the-complete-saga/9n9jjhfp1gh3

It is your mission to face new challenges, new enemies, and defeat the terror of the gods: Fenrir, son of Loki and slayer of Odin during Ragnarok.

This DLC includes the following features:
- 3 New Realms with new enemies, mechanics and outstanding bosses.
- 1 New EPIC Character + skins.
- 3 Themed Skins, each one for a different survivor and related to each of the new realms.
- New Relics, to create new synergies and broken builds.
- Original Soundtrack by Rubén Melià.

You can follow us in our social media to get the news and updates before anyone else.
Twitter: https://twitter.com/NoxfallStudios
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/RhdgScwtm9
